notes: Fenn: slim (13 px shoulders) but with long swept-back ears that stick out past the shoulders (cream fur, pink inner, dark tips), a tool harness with a rack of pouches and tool handles on the back, quick legs: 6-frame walk with a longer stride, 10 fps. Outfit mask = coverall (torso, sleeves, trousers) and the helmet shell. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.
